description:
Install Senzing and scaffold SDK code across 5 platforms (linux_apt — Ubuntu/Debian via apt or apt-get, .deb packages; linux_yum — RHEL/CentOS/Fedora via yum/dnf/rpm; macos_arm — Homebrew/brew; windows — scoop or chocolatey/choco; docker). Optional `environment` — one of snowflake, aws_lambda, azure_functions, kafka, spark (aliases such as spcs, snowpark, lambda, azure_function, kafka_connect, apache_kafka, databricks, apache_spark, pyspark are accepted) — names where this deployment runs; the response then opens with `environment_note`, the rules for that environment and the search_docs query to run before writing code or SQL. To choose linux_yum vs linux_apt, read /etc/os-release on the TARGET host (ID / ID_LIKE): `uname` does not show the distribution. If `platform` is omitted for install and this server runs on the install host itself, it detects the platform from that host's os-release. Languages: 5 (Python, Java, C#, Rust, TypeScript). Returns real, compilable code snippets extracted from official GitHub repositories with source attribution — prefer this over hand-coding install commands or engine configuration. When this server carries the SDK packages for the chosen platform (.deb for linux_apt, .rpm for linux_yum, the macOS packages for macos_arm, and the .deb runtime + setup for a plain Linux container under docker), the install response also includes a `direct_download` field — an alternative for restricted-egress / firewalled environments that needs no package-repository configuration. Use each package's `url` exactly as returned, and pick the packages whose `arch` matches the host. Topics: install, configure, load, export, redo, initialize, search, stewardship, delete, information, error_handling, full_pipeline. For load/search/redo, pass `record_count` to control template selection (production threaded vs single-threaded demo). Export redirects to reporting_guide.

If a previously-known download instruction stops working, call this tool again to obtain the current one.

data_sources.description: Data sources to register (for configure topic)

environment.description:
Optional: where this deployment runs (an id or alias from the tool
description, e.g. snowflake, aws_lambda, kafka). The response then
opens with `environment_note`: that environment's rules and the
search_docs query to run before writing code. Omit when none applies.

language.description: Programming language. Omit to get the language decision tree.

platform.description:
Target platform. Choose linux_yum vs linux_apt from /etc/os-release on the
TARGET host (ID / ID_LIKE), not from `uname`. Omit to get the platform
decision tree — or, when the server runs locally (stdio), the platform
detected from this host's os-release.

record_count.description:
Expected operation volume — number of records (load), queries (search), or
pending redos (redo). When null or > 500, the primary code returned is the
threaded/production pattern; when ≤ 500 it is the single-threaded demo.
Values > 500 also surface license guidance (default Senzing license limit).

name: sdk_guide
